remarks: This isn't just an apartment. It's a lifestyle. Imagine starting your day in a bright, modern eat-in kitchen, then stepping out onto your private balcony with coffee in hand. Your own washer/dryer is waiting downstairs no more coin-ops or laundry runs. At the end of the day, pull right into your two parking spots and head upstairs to relax. With 3 bedrooms and 1.5 baths across 1,450 square feet, you'll have the space to spread out, work from home, and entertain with ease. The best part? You're under a mile from SONO's restaurants, shops, and nightlife. Beaches and parks are minutes away. Whether you're commuting, dining out, or heading to the coast, everything you want is right here. Perks you'll love: Washer/dryer in-unit Two tandem parking spaces Pet-friendly Walkable neighborhood Come see why this townhouse-style apartment is more than just a rental it's the way you want to live.
